notes.title: Morningtide Motel Demo OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
In case you missed it - [i]Slandercast Studio is back with another game![/i] [b]Morningtide Motel [/b]is a narrative-driven motel management game, where you chat with customers, check them into your motel, and learn more about a strange curse that is falling over your country. With so much to do, you find yourself pulling all-nighter after all-nighter, and after weeks of tireless, sleepless nights, you begin wonder… could you even fall asleep if you tried?

[h2]The Demo is Available Now![/h2]

The full release of Morningtide Motel is coming up soon, and in preparation, we are taking part in this months Steam Next Fest! As such, [b]the demo for Morningtide Motel is now available to play[/b], right on the Morningtide Motel store page! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/]Please consider checking it out![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/

As always, thank you so much for playing, and we hope you enjoy [b]Morningtide Motel![/b]

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 2: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Thanks again to everyone who has supported At Winter’s End — we are so grateful to everyone who has played our game, and are excited to bring it to even more of you! We have a handful of small updates for you, and are excited to announce that [b]At Winter’s End is now officially Steam Deck Compatible![/b] Enjoy!

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue stopping achievements from unlocking on Mac
[*] Tweaked input glyphs and tutorials to be more platform-agnostic
[*] Fixed “Report Issue” button not working on certain devices
[*] Fixed certain menu behavior to no longer be framerate dependent
[/list]

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the support, we're really happy to see you all enjoying At Winter's End! The update today is pretty minor, just fixing a couple of small issues we've noticed.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Day 3 story branch logic
[*] Fixed an issue with Day 3 achievement unlocks
[*] Tweaked colliders in Capybara's Hollow and Pond
[/list]
